ashfall.name: Cinderfall
ashfall.description: Volcanic ash settles over the Cinderkin Warrens. Ore is plentiful, but enemies are restless.

spring_bloom.name: Hearthfall Bloom
spring_bloom.description: A surge of spring life supplies lumber and useful provisions.

grave_mist.name: Ashen Grave Mist
grave_mist.description: A ghostly mist thickens over the barrows, empowering the restless dead.

river_flood.name: River Flood
river_flood.description: Swollen rivers carry plentiful fish downstream.

merchant_fair.name: Frontier Trade Fair
merchant_fair.description: Travelling merchants exchange goods at unusually favorable rates.

rift_surge.name: Astral Rift Surge
rift_surge.description: Unstable rift currents empower magical studies and awaken dangerous foes.
